thread:
Maya: Quick syncAcmeHealth wants a quant-fallback + cache guidance for long-context RAG. Theyre worried about quality drop past 8k. Need priority call for next sprint.

Liam: My vote: eval-triggered alerts first (fast, reduces risk), cache heuristics second, quant-fallback as opt-in prototype.

Neha: Alerts are low lift. Basic plan: ingest customer eval set, compute per-route deltas, fire alerts to #ops + webhook. Feature-flagged initially.

Samir: Quant-fallback needs routing and compatibility checks. Prototype estimate: 2w to get routing shim + basic health checks, 1w to integrate canary. Hardening later.

Elen: CS note: AcmeHealth wants fallback guarantee before committing Dedicated. Suggest offering opt-in for verified model pairs to limit scope.

Maya: MVP scope suggested: MUST: eval-triggered alerts (ops+slack). SHOULD: small KV/prefix cache tweaks (TTL, hot-key detection). COULD: opt-in quant fallback for verified pairs. Gate criteria: a) alert FP rate <10% on validation, b) pass Acme sample tests, c) rollback runbook + SLOs documented.

Liam: Can we parallelize? Ship alerts this sprint; start quant prototype with an eng pair in parallel.

Samir: I'll pair with Neha for prototype work. Allocation: 20% this sprint for setup, 50% next for validation.

Neha: Need ~50 labeled prompts from Acme to tune thresholds. Initial rule example: 
```
rule: eval_drop
metric: answer_f1
threshold: -6% relative
window: 1h
notify: #ops
```

Maya: @Samir @Neha sync with @Elen on acceptance tests and compliance checklist. Also need quick cost delta for fallback spinups.

Elen: I'll request labeled prompts and confirm hosted vs on-prem expectation. Pulling finance for unit-cost estimate.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary workspace for quant-proto scheduled 2025-11-06T14:00Z (ticket RD-1983).

Liam: Plan for sprint planning: ship eval-triggered alerts as MVP. Kickoff quant prototype as separate track. Maya to post acceptance criteria + PR link by EOD Friday.

Maya: Will do. Action items: 1) Neha - eval signals list, 2) Samir - prototype routing sketch, 3) Elen - timeline for prompt delivery. Thanks.
